treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Estonia and the Sultanate of Oman for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2024)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 46. | Oman | 05.12.2019 + changes through correspondence | 27.10.2024 | 23.10.2025 ( est / eng ) | 24.11.2025 | 01.01.2026 |
source_title: EE-OM Agreement 2024 with Protocol, English text (Riigi Teataja annex Est_Oman_agreement.pdf)

rates.quote: a) zero per cent (0%) of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least twenty per cent (20%) of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) ten per cent (10%) of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed five per cent (5%) of the gross amount of the interest.
the tax so charged shall not exceed eight per cent (8%) of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Article 28 Entitlement to Benefits: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless ...

notes: Dividends and interest exempt at source when paid to listed government bodies (Estonian Government/local authorities, Bank of Estonia, Rural Development Foundation, Estonian Business and Innovation Agency; Oman Government, Central Bank, OIA, Oman Development Bank, ECGA) or to investment funds, pension funds or pension schemes per Art. 4(1) (Arts 10(3), 11(3)). Effective (Art. 29) in both States for WHT on amounts paid/credited from 1 January 2026. Dividend 0% tier drafted as a 0% cap. Protocol 1(b) preserves domestic anti-avoidance rules.
